title: Ollama
description: Connection to an Ollama server, for chat turns and the embeddings of collections. Chat and embedding requests name the connection and a model explicitly; there is no default model.

ollama.description: Identifier flag of the ollama connection type

url.title: URL
url.description: Base URL of the Ollama API including the /api suffix, e.g. http://ollama:11434/api

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: HTTP timeout of chat requests; omitted or larger than the turn deadline = the turn deadline (dmstr_neuron_ai.turn.deadline_seconds)

auth_type.title: Authentication
auth_type.description: How requests to the Ollama server authenticate, e.g. behind a reverse proxy: none (default), bearer (static token) or client_credentials (OAuth2 client credentials, e.g. Keycloak)

token.title: Token
token.description: Static bearer token sent as Authorization: Bearer (auth_type bearer only); stored encrypted, never returned

token_url.title: Token URL
token_url.description: HTTPS token endpoint of the OAuth2 server, e.g. https://keycloak.example.org/realms/example/protocol/openid-connect/token (auth_type client_credentials only)

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret (auth_type client_credentials only); stored encrypted, never returned

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Optional space-separated OAuth2 scopes of the token request (auth_type client_credentials only)

tool_models.title: Models released for tools
tool_models.description: Models of this connection that agents with MCP tools and POST /chat with mcpConnections may use, e.g. ["qwen3:14b", "gemma4:26b"]; llama3.2 also matches llama3.2:latest. Empty or omitted = every model. Checked at agent publish and on POST /chat, after the tools capability of the model catalogue
